mechanism: Deutetrabenazine is metabolized by CYP2D6 and sulfasalazine may have minor CYP2D6 inhibitory effects; additive CNS depression and potential for increased extrapyramidal effects.
action: Monitor for increased deutetrabenazine adverse effects (sedation, parkinsonism, akathisia); consider CYP2D6 status and adjust deutetrabenazine dose if needed.
